clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal, Executor Zygand sends Forsaken agents from Brill against the Scarlet Crusade. Captain Melrache and his personal vanguard hold a ruined watchtower past Faol's Rest.

The Forsaken are securing the ruins of Lordaeron while Scarlet Crusade forces keep probing Tirisfal's borders. From a watchtower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest, crusaders lead raids against Forsaken patrols and lands. Executor Zygand chooses to strike at the officers directing those raids instead of waiting for another attack.

Captain Melrache commands the northern camp, with two sworn bodyguards always at his side. From the tower, the Scarlet Crusade can watch the coastal roads and nearby woods. Killing Melrache breaks the raiders' coordination near Brill, removes a direct threat to Lady Sylvanas's young kingdom, and drives the zealots back toward their stronger fortifications farther east.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest. According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.
I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission. Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have not yet performed your duty, adventurer. We cannot expect to carry out The Dark Lady's plan with the Scarlet Crusade pestering our soldiers. Bring about their deaths and perform your duty to Sylvanas!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done extremely well, adventurer. With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The Forsaken our race is one step closer to defeating Arthas once and for all. I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
